name: Order Price Data 2
definition: Prices related to an order in financial instruments.

LimitPrice.name: Limit Price
LimitPrice.definition: Maximum price at which a buy order can trade or the minimum price at which a sell order can trade.

StopPrice.name: Stop Price
StopPrice.definition: Price that must be reached for the order to become active. All prices should be

AdditionalLimitPrice.name: Additional Limit Price
AdditionalLimitPrice.definition: Any other limit price which may apply to the order.

PeggedPrice.name: Pegged Price
PeggedPrice.definition: Maximum price at which a pegged order to buy can trade or the minimum price at which a pegged order to sell can trade.

CurrencySecondLeg.name: Currency Second Leg
CurrencySecondLeg.definition: Currency in which leg 2 of the contract is denominated, for  multi-currency or cross-currency swaps.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: LimitPrice must be present or |StopPrice must be present or |AdditionalLimitPrice must be present or |PeggedPrice must be present or |CurrencySecondLeg must be present.
